body:
This isn't a useful test, it doesn't even use `OccluderPolygon2D`. At best it mimics other code that is in core which means it adds nasty technical debt since the unwritten expectation is that any time the related code in core is changed this needs to be updated as well. 

Realistically, this is just a wasteful test that adds bloat for no gain
